events.body:
Resend is a developer email platform that lets you configure webhooks and inspect what happens after a transactional email is sent. Delivery becomes a separate event you can examine, not just a send response.

Each webhook message provides concrete post-send context, including the event payload, endpoint response, delivery attempts, and replay events. That makes it possible to investigate delivery outcomes with the data attached to each event.

For a bounded first test, configure one delivery-event webhook and use Resend’s documented test recipient addresses. They simulate delivered, bounced, and spam-complaint events without sending to real recipients or affecting your domain reputation.

Review the test email guide to generate and inspect an event. This tests event generation and inspection; it does not validate production endpoint reliability, application-specific handling, or inbox placement.

events.body:
A send response covers the request to send. Delivery and bounce happen afterward, so investigating an outcome requires the event generated after the send.

Resend is a developer email platform whose webhooks notify your application about email events. Its dashboard provides a place to inspect those events, making post-send outcomes separate from the initial send response.

Configure one webhook for a delivery event, then send a test to delivered@resend.dev. Resend also supplies test addresses for bounced and spam-complaint events, without sending to real recipients or affecting your domain reputation.

This first test demonstrates event generation and inspection. It does not validate production endpoint reliability, application-specific handling, or inbox placement.

events.subject: Inspect transactional email delivery events
events.preview_text: Capture one documented delivery signal at your endpoint.
events.body:
Resend lets you inspect what happens after a transactional email is sent. Its webhooks give your application a delivery event to capture, rather than treating a successful send request as the end of the observable workflow.

Register a publicly accessible endpoint and select `email.delivered`. Resend will send the selected event to your route as a real-time JSON POST request, creating a concrete delivery signal you can log and inspect.

The event does not guarantee inbox placement. It gives you a documented starting point for deciding whether Resend’s webhook format and delivery signal fit your transactional-email observability needs.

Register an email.delivered endpoint

events.subject: Inspect delivery after sending
events.preview_text: Capture an email.delivered event as a JSON POST request.
events.body:
Sending a transactional email starts the workflow. Inspecting what happened afterward requires a separate delivery signal your application can capture.

Resend is a developer email platform that sends selected email events to a registered endpoint as real-time JSON POST requests. Subscribe to `email.delivered` to create a concrete event you can inspect during debugging.

The first step is to register a publicly accessible endpoint and select `email.delivered`. When that event occurs, Resend sends its details to your route in a JSON payload.

Follow the webhook guide to register the endpoint and evaluate whether the event format fits your application’s observability needs. The delivery event confirms delivery activity; it does not guarantee inbox placement.
